judged_text: [High/data] Recurring collective-booking cancellation iterates all calendar references but deletes only each updated booking’s first calendar reference with every credential, causing incorrect targeting and duplicate/wrong-calendar deletes.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the handleCancelBooking.ts diff around lines 415-470, the code now iterates through bookingCalendarReference (an array of calendar references). For recurring events with allRemainingBookings, the inner loop iterates through updatedBookings and for each finds only the first calendar reference with `.find()` (line 'const bookingRef = updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))'). This means if a collective booking has multiple calendar references (one per team member), only the first one gets deleted for each updated booking. Additionally, the outer loop iterates through all credentials that end with '_calendar' for each reference, which could cause duplicate delete attempts. This is a real bug where the refactoring to support multiple destination calendars didn't properly handle the recurring event cancellation case.
